samples.scenario: A phishing campaign targets personal users by impersonating a popular online fashion retailer (stylehub.com) offering a fake clearance sale. The email uses an obfuscated URL with a hexadecimal IP address pointing to a malicious server hosting a clone of the retailer's checkout page. Victims who enter their payment information have their data stolen by the attacker.
